newsitem.title: USA: Tosco N.J. refinery restart going smoothly.
newsitem.headline: Tosco N.J. refinery restart going smoothly.

text.p: Tosco Corp's restart this week of its 140,000 barrel per day (bpd) catalytic cracker at its Bayway refinery in Linden, New Jersey is proceeding smoothly according to New Jersey environmental regulators.

The unit, the largest cat cracker in the world, was shut down in early January to undergo maintenance following a fire-related outage in early December. The refinery has total crude distillation capacity of 290,000 bpd.
Tosco officials declined to comment on day-to-day operations at the refinery, which traders have dubbed the "gasoline machine."
Some gasoline traders said they do not expect the unit to be up to full capacity until sometime during the coming weekend.

One trader said the unit, restarted on Wednesday, may have experienced a slight problem on Thursday, sending catalyst into the air surrounding the facility, but that could not be immediately confirmed.
